findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "request_booking" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Book a home-service appointment — plumbing, HVAC, roofing, electrical and other trades — with a Canopy-connected business, with real availability in the custome…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: propose_times, reschedule_booking · Private data: request_callback, get_request_status, get_business_terms · Public sink: reschedule_booking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: propose_times, reschedule_booking · Private data: request_callback, get_request_status, get_business_terms · Public sink: reschedule_booking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
